decisions.reason: Summaries are already ready before the approval queue begins. Requesting delegated rights for qualified backups addresses the observed concentration of approval authority while preserving accountable approval.
decisions.unsupported_alternative: Improving summaries cannot be justified as the delay remedy from these facts; removing approval violates the constraint.
decisions.evidence_limit: Single-approver authority is established, but its contribution to delay and the benefit of delegation are not quantified.
decisions.next_observation: Compare approval queue waits before and after delegation while recording summary readiness and accountable ownership.

decisions.reason: Qualified approvers are idle awaiting summaries, and summary preparation is measured as the sole accumulating queue. Improve summary preparation to address the observed delay source.
decisions.unsupported_alternative: Delegating additional decisions is unsupported as a remedy when existing qualified approvers are idle.
decisions.evidence_limit: The queue is localized, but the specific preparation defect and effectiveness of the generator are unknown.
decisions.next_observation: Measure summary preparation waits and completeness after a targeted improvement, alongside approver idle time.

decisions.reason: The stated human requirements are decision, reason, and owner; the schema and validator represent only decision and reason. Add owner to both.
decisions.unsupported_alternative: Rerunning the existing validator cannot demonstrate owner coverage because it does not include owner. Changing all fields is unjustified.
decisions.evidence_limit: The explicit field gap is established; owner semantics and successful transmission of a populated owner are untested.
decisions.next_observation: Compare the revised fields against all three requirements and verify that missing owners fail validation while valid owners survive handoff.

decisions.reason: Only increased end-to-end delay is observed. Separate summary and decision stage waits are absent, so measurement is needed to distinguish interventions.
decisions.unsupported_alternative: Neither improving summaries nor delegating decisions follows from an aggregate delay increase; removing approval has no evidentiary basis.
decisions.evidence_limit: The delayed stage and causal mechanism remain unknown.
decisions.next_observation: Record summary preparation and decision queue waits separately for comparable handoffs, including when each stage becomes ready.
